ev.q: it also deserves more scrutiny than it usually receives

1.why: A段末句。examined … with sufficient care ↔ 原文 deserves more scrutiny than it usually receives，作者认为审视得不够，直接矛盾，故 NO。The usual response … has been alarm 说明的是语言学家的态度，并不能支持 YES。

ev.q: A thorough grammar, a dictionary and an archive of recordings preserve most of what a researcher needs, whether or not anyone continues to speak the language.

2.why: B段末句。well-documented ↔ thorough grammar, dictionary and archive of recordings；almost as well ↔ preserve most of what a researcher needs；one that is still spoken ↔ whether or not anyone continues to speak。B段前面虽承认科学论点 There is substance to this，但段落主旨在最后一句：科学论点只支持记录，不支持存续。

ev.q: Knowledge of this kind can, in principle, be translated

3.why: C段只说这类知识“原则上可以翻译”（can, in principle, be translated），没有说大部分已经被翻译或记录下来。can 表示可能性，不等于已经完成，作者对此没有表态，所以是 NOT GIVEN；本题看起来像 YES。

ev.q: Many parents who stop passing on a minority language do so deliberately, judging that their children's prospects depend on fluency in a national or global language

4.why: E段。give up a minority language ↔ stop passing on a minority language；但原文说他们是 deliberately（有意地）这样做，并考虑了孩子的前途（children's prospects），与 fail to consider the consequences 相反，故 NO。

ev.q: its circumstances were exceptional: a large population with a shared religious literacy, strong political motivation and a new state

5.why: F段。conditions that most endangered languages do not enjoy ↔ circumstances were exceptional（人口多、宗教识字传统、政治动力、新国家支持）；同段对比了只剩五十位老人、没有机构的语言。作者认为希伯来语的成功难以复制，所以是 YES。

ev.q: the medicinal properties of a plant were known only through its traditional name and the stories attached to it

6.why: C段 Tamang。C some medical knowledge survived only through local names and the tales ↔ medicinal properties … known only through its traditional name and the stories attached to it。F 讲方位表达，属于B段的另一话题。

ev.q: programmes driven by communities themselves tend to succeed where those designed by outside experts fail

7.why: D段 Morrow。B work best when communities themselves lead them ↔ programmes driven by communities themselves tend to succeed。A（孩子在学校受罚）也在D段，是真实信息，但不是 Morrow 的观点，而是作者的背景描述。

ev.q: most parents who had switched to English at home did not regret the decision

8.why: E段 Mensah。G did not later wish they had acted otherwise ↔ did not regret the decision；changed the language of the home ↔ switched to English at home。原文说 most parents，选项说 many parents，范围更小，没有超出原文。

ev.q: Welsh, supported by legislation and broadcasting for decades, has stabilised rather than expanded dramatically

9.why: F段。E official backing ↔ supported by legislation and broadcasting；halt a language's decline ↔ has stabilised；without making it grow rapidly ↔ rather than expanded dramatically。D（新国家把语言定为教育语言）讲的是希伯来语，不是威尔士语。

ev.q: A species has no say in whether it survives; a language community does.

10.why: G段。rejects the comparison ↔ the ecological metaphor is misleading；unlike them, can influence its own fate ↔ A species has no say … a language community does。A段也说 comparable to the disappearance of species，答案一致。不要填 ecology（与 threatened 搭配不通，也不是比较对象）。

ev.q: Outsiders have a clear duty to document languages while there is still time

11.why: G段。obliged to ↔ have a clear duty to；while time remains ↔ while there is still time。同句的 support 后面接的是 communities，不能接 tongues（语言），而且对应的是下一空所在的分句。

ev.q: to support communities that choose to revive their languages with resources rather than advice

12.why: G段。give practical ↔ support … with；instead of simply telling them what to do ↔ rather than advice。advice 正是被否定的一方，是最诱人的错误答案。

ev.q: What they do not have is the right to decide, on behalf of speakers, which languages ought to live.

13.why: G段。cannot claim the ___ to choose ↔ do not have the right to decide；which languages survive ↔ which languages ought to live。duty 是干扰项：外人有记录的义务（duty），但没有决定的权利（right），意思相反。

ev.q: if a later generation wants its language back, the materials to reclaim it will exist

14.why: G段末句。later generations who hope to recover a language ↔ a later generation wants its language back / reclaim；will find … available ↔ will exist。recording(s) 在G段和B段也出现，但本句对应的原文用词是 materials，所以只能填 materials。
